profile.description: Low-TTFA VNNI profile for an AWS c8a.4xlarge (AMD EPYC 9R45, Zen 5 Turin, 16 cores, no AMX). This is the host on which the AVX-512-BF16 prefill-default fix was measured.

hardware.notes: AWS c8a.4xlarge: 16 vCPU exposed as 16 physical cores, SMT off, one NUMA node, ~30 GiB RAM. No AMX. Measured STREAM Triad ~106.5 GB/s. A pooled DRAM-resident micro-benchmark (tests/x86_b1_gemv_bench) measured the INT8 B=1 GEMV at 83-105 GB/s of weight bytes and the B=2 matmat at 79-96 GB/s across the dominant CP/Talker shapes at 8 threads, i.e. both are already at the practical memory roof on this host. WARNING: the l3 figure reported by lscpu on a cloud slice is the SOCKET L3, not the slice share, so it is left unset here.

server.worker_affinity: worker 0 -> CPUs 0-7; worker 1 -> CPUs 8-15; SMT is not exposed on this host

precision.activations: fp32 at the API boundary; AVX-512 vectorized int8 packing is internal to VNNI matvec and matmat
precision.gemm_backend: AVX-512 VNNI tiled INT8 GEMM for batched shapes, AVX-512 VNNI GEMV for single-slot shapes, and AVX-512 BF16 matmat for bf16 projections

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: Must be absent so the engine sizes OpenBLAS from the worker phase budget; an inherited value can override the measured topology.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.revert: Set it only for a measured control run.

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: Used by the measured VNNI server runs to prevent idle OpenBLAS workers from competing with the engine pool.

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: Keeps the request-independent prefix path enabled for repeated serving requests.

QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT.why: LOAD-BEARING on a non-AMX host, not just a pin for auditability. Measured 2026-09-03 on AWS c8a.4xlarge (EPYC 9R45, 16c, no AMX), server mode, 4 sequential arms with a process-clean proof before each: TTFA p50 416 -> 124 ms at C=1 and p95 939 -> 507 ms at C=4, TOTAL_RTF -13% at C=4, with the delta localised in the server-side 'admission + prefill' stage (2844 -> 1126 ms). Before the qwen_avx512_bf16_matmat_available() fix the compiled default on AVX-512-BF16 hosts without AMX fell back to converting every weight matrix to f32 and calling SGEMM, and the conversion (bf16_to_f32_matrix) is single-threaded, so it became a serial stage in front of a parallel GEMM. The engine now enables this path by itself on such hosts; the pin is kept so the profile stays explicit. NOTE: it changes the sampled trajectory (mel-corr ~0.4-0.8 vs the SGEMM path, same prompt) - on this host the matmat output was judged better by ear.
QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT.revert: QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT=0 routes the prefill projections through BLAS (slower TTFA on this host)

QWEN_PREFILL_QUANT.why: Deliberately absent because quantized prefill is not part of the quality-preserving reference configuration.
QWEN_PREFILL_QUANT.revert: QWEN_PREFILL_QUANT=1 only for a separately qualified base-model control.

QWEN_CP_PREFILL2.why: Keeps the two-position CP prefill path enabled and makes its state auditable in the flag report.

QWEN_POOL_SPIN.why: Scaleway-specific interleaved sweep: 4096 beat 0 and 65536 at C=1/C=4. Spin 0 reached about 110k context switches/s and lowered throughput; 65536 also lowered C=4 throughput. 4096 is pinned for reproducibility.
QWEN_POOL_SPIN.revert: Unset to use the compiled default.

QWEN_DECODER_BATCH.why: Scaleway-specific interleaved 3x A/B: off averaged about 179/291 ms TTFA p50/p95 at C=4 versus 191/309 ms on, with equivalent throughput. The batch wait did not pay on this workload.

QWEN_STREAM_DECODE_CHUNK.why: The measured 2x8 VNNI runs used an eight-frame steady-state decode chunk; values 4 and 16 remain unqualified alternatives.
QWEN_STREAM_DECODE_CHUNK.revert: Set another chunk size only for a measured A/B.

QWEN_STREAM_DECODE_CHUNK_BUSY.why: Keeps the busy-stream override disabled in the measured baseline.
QWEN_STREAM_DECODE_CHUNK_BUSY.revert: Set a nonzero value only for a measured control.

QWEN_VNNI_GEMV_MR.why: The measured VNNI baseline uses the two-row GEMV kernel. The four-row candidate did not show a stable end-to-end win on this workload.

QWEN_VNNI_PREPACK.why: Candidate only. Parent-side CP prepack created 41 matrices (~102 MB) and preserved audio byte-for-byte, but the corrected AVX-512 BF16 + VNNI A/B did not improve C=4 p95 or total RTF. Keep it out of the deployment profile until another host or workload shows a stable win.
QWEN_VNNI_PREPACK.revert: QWEN_VNNI_PREPACK=cp or QWEN_VNNI_PREPACK=1 for a separate measured candidate run.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_ACT_QUANT.why: Must remain absent so AVX-512 activation quantization is used. Disabling it was slower in isolated VNNI matmat/QKV measurements and in the C=4 server comparison.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_ROWSUM.why: Must remain absent so the cached INT8 row sums are reused by VNNI GEMV. Disabling the cache was slower in the isolated shape benchmark.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.why: Must remain absent so the shape-aware AVX-512 VNNI tiled matmat path remains available. Scaleway interleaved A/B showed no material end-to-end difference from disabling it, so it is retained as the safer native path but not advertised as a measured speedup.

QWEN_VNNI_NCHUNK.why: Not pinned globally. A 256-row candidate slightly improved C=4 median TTFA but did not improve p95 or throughput consistently; it remains an objective-specific experiment.
QWEN_VNNI_NCHUNK.revert: Set QWEN_VNNI_NCHUNK=256 only for a paired TTFA A/B.

qualification.workload: Sequential server-mode A/B, four arms (OFF, ON, OFF, ON) at client concurrency 1 and 4, one wave each, two prefork workers with eight threads each, realistic English bank. Every arm was preceded by a kill of all harnesses/servers and a pgrep proof of zero surviving processes; a single build was used for all four arms.
qualification.notes: Measured 2026-09-03, binary sha256 6fa2b89e98e504463607ea826e99e32f. QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT A/B, replicas in brackets. OFF: TTFA p50 423/410 ms at C=1 and p50 930/900, p95 950/928 ms at C=4; TOTAL_RTF 0.816/0.814 at C=1 and 1.167/1.173 at C=4; server-side admission+prefill 2844/2831 ms. ON: TTFA p50 125/123 ms at C=1 and p50 494/477, p95 516/498 ms at C=4; TOTAL_RTF 0.729/0.730 and 1.024/1.002; admission+prefill 1122/1130 ms. STREAM_RTF was unchanged (0.936 vs 0.925 at C=4), confirming the delta is a one-time prefill cost, and Talker/CP absolute times were unchanged. Zero errors and zero rejections in all arms; audio sha256 identical between replicas of the same arm. Separately, a canonical Poisson run at 0.30 req/s (24 requests, mean in-flight 2.09) measured TTFA p50 178 ms, p95 513 ms, RTF p50 1.01 and Q 2.25 with zero errors, and decode occupancy of B1 58.0% / B2 27.8% / B3 11.1% / B4 3.1% per worker.
